### Welcome! -->

<!-- [**Welcome!**]{style="font-weight: 600; font-size: 18pt; color: #496130;"} -->

**Welcome!**

<div style="text-align: justify; font-weight: 400; font-size: 13pt;">


I am a [Postdoctoral Fellow](https://www.pop.upenn.edu/bio/angelo-dos-santos) at the University of Pennsylvania and Scientific Production Coordinator for the [DZC project](https://web.sas.upenn.edu/dzc-en/).

I am an applied microeconomist working on development and environmental economics. 

My research spans two broad areas: the drivers and governance of deforestation; and the effects of environmental exposures on human development, including the role of climate adaptation in mitigating them.

Outside of research, I love spending time in nature and playing football.

You can find my CV [here](documents/cv_angelodossantos.pdf)

</div>
